title: Animals, Birds, and Dr. Dolittle
subject: English
summary: “Animals, Birds, and Dr. Dolittle” is a story about a kind doctor named Dr. Dolittle who loves animals and birds. He understands that animals have feelings and can communicate with one another. He learns their language and becomes a good friend to them. Instead of treating only human beings, he spends his time helping sick and injured animals. His love and care for animals make him very special. The story teaches us that we should love, care for and protect animals and birds because they are also important living beings.
